notes.title: 🔶Epilogue Update | Now Available!🔶
notes.notes:
Take Me to the Dungeon!! Epilogue is now available on Steam! 🎉

When our game launched in June last year, we were incredibly honored and happy to see how much everyone loved this game. To respond to your enthusiasm, we've poured our hearts into creating this epilogue, embracing the feedback we've received from our dedicated players. 

For a small team like us, this has been a long journey, and thanks to player support, we've made it this far and even secured exciting brand partnerships.

Thank you again, and we hope you'll enjoy this update! Don't forget to check out our partner Lovense's website! 🙇

notes.title: 🔶Epilogue Update | 2🔶
notes.notes:
Take Me to the Dungeon!! Epilogue launches tomorrow! While we know you all enjoy the card battle system, we've also prepared some brand new CGs! And for those seeking an extra challenge, a new high-difficulty dungeon awaits!

─Update Content─
⚔️Abyss Dungeon:
A new challenge unlocked after completing the epilogue! Start with a fixed deck and acquire random cards as you venture deeper. Test both your luck and skills!

❤️Beautiful CGs:
10 new CGs in total, including additional general CGs for the main story and new ones for the epilogue!

🔧Enhanced Features:
Adjustable difficulty settings, instant CG unlock after completion, customizable gallery playback, and unlimited card effect levels - delivering the ultimate gaming experience!
──────

Finally, for those with special needs, we hear you! Not just the front needs care, the back needs some "warmth" too. 🌼

Special recommendation for you, the adjustable prostate massager "Edge2" lets you comfortably reach your sensitive spots with multi-angle movements, massaging your sweet spot. Paired with the "Solace series" introduced in our previous post, you can experience double the stimulation, and they can sync together!

And for our lady players, we haven't forgotten about you! 💦

Special recommendation for you, Bluetooth Egg Vibrator "Lush 3"! Dual-head design with multiple vibration patterns, hitting the G-spot! Perfectly syncs with the game too! 💓

notes.title: Epilogue Update | 1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Only two days left until the Epilogue update of Take Me to the Dungeon!! goes live! We have: new adventures, new characters, new cards, new systems, new dungeons, and new CGs, all as FREE updates! We'll be revealing more details gradually to give you a sneak peek!

─Update Content─
😈EX Stage:
Face the mysterious new character "Noah" in brand new stages. And finally, someone's mysterious past will be revealed?!

💪Companion System:
Fight alongside former enemies: Succubus Queen, Vampire Queen, Pamela, and Mona, each with their unique combat styles!

🃏New Cards:
Discover the “Persistence,” "Bloodshed,” and “All-In” series that recall discarded cards at the cost of HP; explore the new high-risk, high-reward “Self-Sacrifice” deck archetype, and many more cards waiting to be discovered!
──────

Furthermore, to provide players with an enhanced experience, we're collaborating with the renowned adult toy brand Lovense— you can now connect your toys to the game, allowing H-scenes to provide direct feedback, making you feel like you're truly in the game with your favorite characters🩷

Special recommendation for you, the "Solace" series masturbators! Simply use the Lovense APP to connect with the game easily. With multi-speed design and adjustable stroke depth control, let them take care of your lower half of your body automatically while your hands focus on playing cards🦾

To celebrate this collaboration, all related toys are now on special offer. For details, please visit:
Lovense exclusive sale: https://bit.ly/4gznQgP
Game landing page : https://bit.ly/41xiIWh

Stay tuned for tomorrow's update!
